descriptions.notStarted: I found it! I found Bob again! He must have escaped from The Rememberer by himself! I feel really terrible that I let this kind of things happen. I am going back to The Rememberer to tell him to lighten up.
descriptions.inProgress: I don't think The Rememberer gets the whole idea of me doing this. Bob may be just another monster but I know what is right or wrong. And I am going to pay back just the way he did to me. I need to get 1 #b#t4000019##k other than Bob's to pull this off.
descriptions.completed: I got him! The Remeberer will always remember this day. The day he got tricked by me! Ok. I should stop doing things like this though.
